# Medical News Today

> > Medical News Today provides evidence-based health information covering chronic disease management, prescription medications, mental health conditions, and healthcare navigation.

Medical News Today is a comprehensive health information resource that references authoritative sources including the FDA, CDC, Medicare, and medical associations. The site covers clinical topics ranging from diabetes and neurological conditions to prescription drug guidance and insurance coverage, serving both patients and healthcare consumers seeking reliable medical information.

## Key Topics

- Medicare coverage and insurance
- FDA-approved medications
- Diabetes management and blood sugar control
- Weight loss strategies
- Drug side effects and safety
- CDC health guidelines
- Financial assistance for medications
- Mental health conditions (ADHD, OCD, depression)
- Chronic disease management
- Neurological disorders
- Prescription drug pricing
- Telehealth and healthcare access
- Elderly health and aging
- Biologic drugs and biosimilars

## Chronic Disease Management

- [Does drinking water lower blood sugar? What to know](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/does-drinking-water-lower-blood-sugar): Explains water's impact on blood sugar per ADA and Diabetes UK guidance
- [What is a suitable amount of sugar when trying to lose weight?](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/how-much-sugar-per-day-to-lose-weight): WHO and Dietary Guidelines recommendations on added sugar for weight loss
- [Health conditions in older age](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/common-elderly-health-issues): Overview of elderly health issues with Medicare and SSDI coverage info
- [How to prevent falls in the home](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/how-to-prevent-falls-at-home): CDC and NIA guidance on home safety modifications for seniors
- [Parkinson's plus syndromes: Symptoms, causes, and treatments](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/parkinsons-plus-syndromes): Covers PSP, multiple system atrophy, and atypical parkinsonism disorders

## Mental Health Conditions

- [ADHD complications: Types and when to speak with a doctor](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/adhd-complications): CDC data on ADHD comorbidities and social/work complications
- [Does OCD come and go? Triggers and treatment options](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/does-ocd-come-and-go): OCD symptom fluctuation with CBT and ERP therapy treatment options
- [Does Mounjaro cause depression? Research, causes, and what to do](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/drugs-does-mounjaro-cause-depression): Reviews FDA data on tirzepatide's mental health effects and depression risk
- [Schizophrenia and the eyes: Is there a link?](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/schizophrenia-eyes): DSM-5 schizophrenia eye movement patterns and retinal changes explored

## Prescription Medications and Drug Information

- [Opdivo Qvantig cost: Financial assistance options](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/drugs-opdivo-qvantig-cost): Cost guide for nivolumab cancer drug with Bristol Myers Squibb assistance
- [Xolremdi side effects: Common, mild, and serious](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/drugs-xolremdi-side-effects): FDA-approved mavorixafor side effects for WHIM syndrome treatment
- [Qutenza dosage: Form, strength, how to use, and more](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/drugs-qutenza-dosage): Capsaicin patch dosing for neuropathic and diabetic pain via TRPV1
- [Wegovy (semaglutide) on Reddit: Top drug questions answered](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/drugs-wegovy-reddit): Reddit user questions on Wegovy vs Zepbound and food aversions addressed
- [Vraylar Reddit reviews: Weight loss, side effects, user insights](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/vraylar-reddit): FDA-approved cariprazine reviews from Reddit on weight and akathisia

## Medicare and Healthcare Coverage

- [Medicare MAGI: What it means for IRMAA](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/medicare-magi): Explains MAGI income brackets affecting Medicare Part B and D premiums
- [Understanding Medicare's national coverage determinations (NCDs)](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/medicare-national-coverage-determinations): CMS NCD policies and MEDCAC advisory process for Medicare coverage
- [How to find the right doctor online: Tips to consider](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/how-to-find-the-right-doctor-online): Guide to selecting doctors via HMO/PPO networks and telehealth options

## Skin Conditions and Dermatology

- [Why hives might appear on the stomach and how to treat them.](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/hives-on-stomach): Covers urticaria causes, antihistamine treatments, and when to see a doctor
- [Hives vs. shingles: Pictures, symptoms, and treatment options](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/hives-vs-shingles): AAD-based comparison of hives and varicella-zoster virus shingles

## Optional
